```{r FullCode, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE}
library(partykit)
library(caret)
#load("C:/Users/Lucas/Desktop/Seminar DS/Churn.RData")
load("C:/Users/User/Desktop/Seminar DS/Churn.RData")
set.seed(123) 
train_index <- sample(1:nrow(data), 0.7 * nrow(data))
train <- data[train_index, ]
test  <- data[-train_index, ]

#Cross-validate alpha
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  verboseIter = TRUE,
  classProbs = FALSE,
  summaryFunction = defaultSummary,
  savePredictions = "final"
)

tune_grid <- expand.grid(mincriterion = seq(0.90, 0.99, by = 0.01))

set.seed(123) 
train(
  Churn ~ ., data = train,
  method = "ctree",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = tune_grid
)

best_mincriterion <- 0.99

final_model <- ctree(
  Churn ~ .,
  data = train,
  control = ctree_control(mincriterion = best_mincriterion)
)

# Cross-validate accuracy
train_control <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  summaryFunction = defaultSummary
)

# Grid with the BEST value only
final_grid <- expand.grid(mincriterion = best_mincriterion)

set.seed(123)
cv_final <- train(
  Churn ~ ., data = train,
  method = "ctree",
  trControl = train_control,
  tuneGrid = final_grid,
  metric = "Accuracy"
)

cv_final

pred_class <- predict(cv_final, newdata = test)
pred_prob <- predict(cv_final, newdata = test, type = "prob")
table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = test$Churn)
mean(pred_class == test$Churn)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, fig.height=5, fig.width=10}
plot(final_model)
```

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)

conf_df <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(Predicted = pred_class, Actual = test$Churn))
colnames(conf_df) <- c("No (Actual)", "Yes (Actual)")
rownames(conf_df) <- c("No (Predicted)", "Yes (Predicted)")
kable(conf_df, caption = "Confusion Matrix") %>% 
  kable_styling(full_width = FALSE, position = "center")
```
